facts.business: Gayatri Projects Limited is an infrastructure construction company engaged in engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of highways, irrigation, industrial, and power projects.

auditor.name: M/s. Atmakuri & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (i) Impairment provision of Rs 13,342.95 lakhs on CCCPS investment; (ii) Write-off of Rs 13,411.00 lakhs subordinate debt to associate; (iii) Write-off of entire interest receivable on Inter Corporate Loan and recognition of Rs 15,455.00 lakhs as Collateral Security Enforcement under SARFAESI; (iv) Work advances to sub-contractor pending recovery; (v) Recovery of work & other advances and receivables delayed from one sub-contractor.

key_risks: Recovery delays of work advances and receivables from sub-contractors
Impairment of investments in preference shares
Write-off of subordinate debt and interest receivable from associate company
Enforcement of collateral security under SARFAESI Act
Pending recovery of inter-corporate loans and advances
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include receivables from joint ventures (Rs 608.14 lakhs non-current, Rs 20,828.76 lakhs current), loans to associate company (Rs 4,556.01 lakhs fully provided), receivables from companies where KMPs are interested (Rs 326.68 lakhs), and pledge of shares in subsidiaries/associates to lenders.
